title: Fleet energy identity
caption: Total energy is energy per completed task times the number of completed tasks. Cut per-task energy fourfold while volume rises twentyfold and fleet energy rises fivefold. Efficiency per task and absolute demand are separate variables, which is why efficiency targets need an absolute resource budget.

symbols.name: energy per task
symbols.meaning: Measured energy of one completed unit of useful work at a stated boundary

symbols.name: task volume
symbols.meaning: Number of completed tasks over the observation period

symbols.name: fleet energy
symbols.meaning: Total energy the fleet consumes in the period

title: CMOS power equation
caption: Dynamic power scales with the square of supply voltage, which is why voltage is the strongest chip-level lever and why the end of Dennard scaling removed automatic per-node savings. Static leakage flows even when nothing switches, and it can rise with temperature, so cooling and leakage feed back on each other.

symbols.name: activity factor
symbols.meaning: Capacitance-weighted switching per clock cycle; not useful-work utilization

symbols.name: switched capacitance
symbols.meaning: Effective load capacitance of the circuits being switched

symbols.name: supply voltage
symbols.meaning: Rail voltage; enters the dynamic term quadratically

symbols.name: clock frequency
symbols.meaning: Rate of switching opportunities

symbols.name: leakage current
symbols.meaning: Current flowing while transistors are nominally off

title: Power usage effectiveness
caption: The ratio of total facility power to IT-equipment power. A value of 1.1 means ten watts of non-IT overhead per hundred watts of IT load. PUE measures overhead only: idle servers stay inside the IT denominator, and a coal-powered site can beat a solar-powered one on PUE while emitting far more carbon.

symbols.name: facility power
symbols.meaning: Total power at the facility boundary including cooling and facility-side losses

symbols.name: IT power
symbols.meaning: Power inside the IT equipment boundary, including idle and stalled machines

symbols.name: power usage effectiveness
symbols.meaning: Overhead multiplier converting IT energy to facility energy

title: Operational carbon attribution
caption: Emissions equal facility energy times the grid carbon intensity. Holding 2,000 MWh fixed, a 400 g/kWh grid attributes about 800 tonnes against about 40 on a 20 g/kWh hydro grid, a twentyfold spread from placement alone. Attributional accounting uses average factors; consequential scheduling needs the marginal generator.

symbols.name: facility energy
symbols.meaning: Energy measured at the facility boundary over the workload interval

symbols.name: grid carbon intensity
symbols.meaning: Grams of CO2 emitted per kilowatt-hour delivered, average or marginal

symbols.name: operational carbon
symbols.meaning: Emissions attributed to the workload's electricity use

title: Distributed step energy
caption: The Fleet Law with a power meter attached: every exposed second of communication or synchronization is a block of joules because the fleet keeps drawing power while it waits. A quarter of the step in unhidden communication is a quarter of its energy only if power is flat across the step, so the share must be read from a power trace.

symbols.name: average fleet power
symbols.meaning: Mean power draw across the step interval

symbols.name: compute time
symbols.meaning: Local arithmetic work divided across N devices

symbols.name: communication time
symbols.meaning: Exposed collective and transfer time at scale N

symbols.name: synchronization time
symbols.meaning: Waiting at barriers, including straggler exposure

symbols.name: overlapped time
symbols.meaning: Communication hidden under computation

title: Cascade inference energy
caption: A small edge model filters inputs and escalates a fraction p to the cloud. Because radio transmission dwarfs local arithmetic by orders of magnitude per bit, the escalation probability is the lever: the architecture saves energy only when the avoided transfers and cloud work exceed the device's added computation and idle power. Accuracy is a separate test.

symbols.name: local energy
symbols.meaning: Edge inference energy per input, always paid

symbols.name: escalation probability
symbols.meaning: Fraction of inputs escalated to the cloud, measured on the deployment distribution

symbols.name: transmission energy
symbols.meaning: Radio energy of sending one input uplink

symbols.name: cloud inference energy
symbols.meaning: Server-side energy per escalated input

title: Federated versus centralized energy
caption: Federated training pays model downloads and update uploads once per client per round, so communication recurs hundreds of times. It wins on energy only when that repeated communication plus local training beats one raw-data upload per client plus the centralized run. Privacy and energy benefits each need separate evidence.

symbols.name: rounds
symbols.meaning: Federated averaging rounds to reach the quality target

symbols.name: clients per round
symbols.meaning: Participating clients in each round

symbols.name: transfer energies
symbols.meaning: Model download and update upload energy per client per round

symbols.name: raw-data upload
symbols.meaning: One client's cost of uploading its raw training data once

symbols.name: aggregation energy
symbols.meaning: Server aggregation cost per round

title: Amortized embodied carbon
caption: Manufacturing emissions are incurred before the first job runs and are amortized over useful service life. Extending life from three years to five cuts the annualized allocation by 40 percent. Retiring functional hardware for modest efficiency gains can cost more in new manufacturing than it saves in operation; the break-even depends on utilization and grid intensity.

symbols.name: manufacturing carbon
symbols.meaning: Embodied emissions from fabrication, packaging, and transport

symbols.name: service years
symbols.meaning: Useful lifetime over which the burden is spread

symbols.name: annualized share
symbols.meaning: Embodied carbon allocated to each year of service
